verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs state that it generates events every time a verification session changes status. Its guide implements webhooks to notify your app when results become available, so integrations can react automatically without polling. The Sessions API tracks a verification from creation through completion. Missing for 10: the specific lifecycle event names (created, processing, verified, requires_input) are not enumerated in the evidence, webhook signature verification is not documented here, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
